title: An immersed peridynamics method for fluid-driven damage and failure of anisotropic materials
summary: The immersed peridynamics (IPD) method is a fluid-structure interaction (FSI) model to simulate fluid-driven material damage and failure of an immersed structure, in which a peridynamic (PD) constitutive correspondence model is employed within a classical immersed boundary (IB)-type framework to describe stresses, forces, and structural deformations of a structural body, instead of classical continuum mechanics. This paper introduces an extension of the IPD method to simulate fluid-driven structural deformation, damage, and failure of anisotropic materials with complex geometries. We use…
